playerA:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side scrolling action game transparent sprite sheet, original art.
Create EXACTLY TWELVE fully drawn individual cels in an absolutely regular FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS grid. Each cell has ONE same hero, full body including sword/scarf/boots with wide transparent padding, no cell borders or text. All face RIGHT. Orthographic side view with slight three-quarter face, same proportions, same character size across every cell.
Hero: charismatic young furnace knight, expressive visible warm brown face and fierce eye under open-faced pale steel brow helm, windswept charcoal hair. Intricate layered blue-teal steel armor, bright silver rim edges, huge engraved BRONZE gauntlets, red flowing scarf, cream cloth waist tabs, articulated boots, single straight silver sword. Strong painted cel-shaded illustration, exquisite intentional silhouette, bold dark contours, crisp 3-tone painted forms, saturated luminous highlights readable on a dark furnace background. Attractive premium hand painted action game sprite art, no pixelation.
Read grid LEFT TO RIGHT top to bottom, these twelve different anatomy poses:
1 idle upright combat guard sword diagonally down-forward; 2 idle exhale lower guard scarf blowing; 3 walk right long front right-leg stride left arm back sword low; 4 passing step rear heel raised knee forward; 5 opposite long stride and counter-swinging arms; 6 passing step opposite knee high.
7 attack windup: deep crouch torso coiled left, sword drawn BACK over rear shoulder ready to slash right; 8 attack contact: explosive wide lunge RIGHT, torso extended, sword thrust nearly horizontal FAR RIGHT, rear arm stretched back; 9 recovery: weight forward, sword finishing down to right, legs beginning reset.
10 second attack windup: sword HIGH overhead both bronze hands together knees bent; 11 second contact: huge downward diagonal cut to bottom right with front knee bent torso folded forward; 12 recovery: blade low right beside front boot, rear heel lifting.
Every pose is a fresh complete drawing with visibly distinct body joints. No motion streaks covering anatomy, no glows detached from body, no cropped objects, no shadows on floor. REAL transparent background, not checkerboard.

Create TWELVE completely new full-body action cels in a regular FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS grid, exactly one hero per cell. Side-on facing RIGHT. Generous transparent margins separating every cell. High-end crisp hand painted cel illustration, precise dark contours, bright metal edges readable at small game scale. No text, borders, floor shadows, background or detached particles. Transparent background. Same figure scale, keep all boots/sword/scarf uncropped, clear gaps between cells.
Read left to right top to bottom:
1 third combo windup: crouched low, sword pulled far back to LEFT at waist, torso twisted.
2 third contact: explosive upward diagonal slash to upper RIGHT, leading foot far forward, left arm wide behind.
3 third recovery: torso follows rotation, sword extended far right level at chest, stable wide stance.
4 launcher anticipation: extremely deep crouch knees folded, blade low RIGHT close to ground, hands at hip.
5 launcher contact: powerful rising uppercut blade high RIGHT overhead, straightened leading leg, lifted rear knee, entire body rises.
6 launcher recovery: airborne high knee-tuck, sword up BACK beside head, scarf streams down left.
7 dash anticipation: very low forward lean head near hips, sword held low behind, front knee bent.
8 dash burst: nearly horizontal torso lunging RIGHT, long reaching right leg forward and rear leg stretched back, sword held beside right shoulder forward.
9 hurt flinch: chest recoiling backward LEFT, chin up pained expression, sword drops diagonally down right, feet stay planted.
10 hurt recovery: hunched and clutching ribs with free bronze hand, sword low, face determined.
11 jump ascending: both feet airborne, front knee drawn high, back leg bent, sword diagonally up-right.
12 jump descending: legs extend downward braced to land, sword horizontal right in ready guard.
These must be genuinely different articulated poses, no repeated standing hero. Preserve the distinctive detailed face and ornate armor from the reference.
